facts.business: Prime Fresh Limited provides end-to-end fruits and vegetables (F&V) post-harvest supply-chain management and distribution, along with services and 3PL businesses including warehousing, handling, packing, cold-storage management, and other value-added supply-chain services.

segments.name: F&V Post-Harvest Supply-Chain Management and Distribution

capacity_or_capex.item: Operational capacity across inward handling, outward dispatch, sorting, grading, packing, cleaning, loading and unloading

key_risks: Changing demand patterns across select fruits and vegetables
facts.related_party_note: Particulars of Investments, loan made by the Company are provided in Notes to the Financial Statements. Further, The Company has not provided any Guarantees covered under the provisions of Section 186 of the Companies Act, 2013 during the financial Year 2025-26.
